local me = Game.GetLocalPlayer() local unit = UnitManager.GetUnit(me, 7) if unit == nil then print("ERR:UNIT_NOT_FOUND"); print("---END---"); return end
local hash = GameInfo.UnitOperations["UNITOPERATION_AUTOMATE_EXPLORE"].Hash
if not UnitManager.CanStartOperation(unit, hash, nil, nil) then
    print("ERR:CANNOT_AUTOMATE|Unit cannot auto-explore"); print("---END---"); return
end
UnitManager.RequestOperation(unit, hash, {})
print("OK:AUTOMATED|" .. unit:GetX() .. "," .. unit:GetY())
print("---END---")
